menu.about: How safe is this web app?
menu.unpairText: This phone forgets the computer, together with its drafts and what you sent. To use it again, run `agentj pair` on the computer and pair again.

badge.label: Web app
badge.title: How safe is this web app?
badge.p1: What goes between your phone and your computer is encrypted. Our servers can't read it.
badge.p2: This web page itself, though, is loaded from our servers: if someone changed it, they could see what you see here. The phone app we're planning won't have that problem.
badge.hash: This page's version number (for checking it hasn't been changed):
badge.verify: How to check it, and what we keep, is on the Data security page: agentj.app/security/
badge.p3: Drafts and what you sent are kept on this phone only, encrypted; read-aloud uses the phone's own voices and sharing uses the phone's own share sheet.

st.awaiting: Waiting for your computer to approve
st.revoked: This phone was removed by your computer
st.pairFail: Not approved, or the link expired. Run agentj pair on your computer again.

pair.title: Connect to your computer
pair.lead: Your Agent works on your computer; this phone is its remote. No sign-up or login — pair once and it's ready whenever you open it.
pair.step1: On your computer, run `agentj pair`. A QR code appears on screen.
pair.step1ios: On your computer, run `agentj pair --link`. It prints a pairing link.
pair.step2: Tap Scan QR code, or paste the pairing link above.
pair.step2ios: Get that link onto this phone, copy it and paste it below.
pair.step3: Your phone shows a 6-digit code. Type it on your computer, then enter your approval passphrase.
pair.iphone: On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen and open it there. Use Scan QR code here or paste the link. The system Camera opens a separate Safari tab.
pair.scanHint: Camera scanning is unavailable. Paste the pairing link above.
pair.scanNoCam: Camera permission was denied or no camera is available. Allow camera access in settings, or paste the pairing link above.
pair.placeholder: Paste the link from agentj pair --link
pair.badLink: That link is invalid or has expired. Run agentj pair on your computer again.

sas.title: Type this 6-digit code on your computer
sas.lead: Type these 6 digits on your computer, press Enter, then enter your approval passphrase.
sas.note: The code is only shown on this phone. Once your computer approves, the chat opens here by itself.

estop.bannerNote: Your Agent won't take new messages, pending approvals were denied, and scheduled tasks are paused.
estop.confirmText: This ends what your Agent is doing right now, denies every pending approval, cancels batch approvals and pauses all scheduled tasks. It won't take new messages until you tap Resume.
estop.resumeText: Your Agent takes messages again, and scheduled tasks go back to their own on/off settings.

push.offer: Want to know when your Agent replies, even with the screen locked?
push.on: Lock-screen alerts are on (alerts never include content)
push.ios: On iPhone, first tap Share → Add to Home Screen in Safari, then open it from the Home Screen to turn on lock-screen alerts.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
push.failed: Couldn't turn on: this browser doesn't support web push, or the push service can't be reached.

end.device_gone: Batch approval ended (the phone that gave it was removed)

cmd.clearText: Your Agent will forget this conversation. The old one stays on your computer, and you can undo the clear.

ask.batchScope: Similar = {scope} · up to {max} times / {mins} min · ends with this turn · spending, deleting and the like still ask you one by one
ask.left: {n} s left — denied if you don't answer
ask.timeUp: Time's up, waiting for your computer…
ask.noSign: This browser can't sign approvals, so you can't approve here. Use the latest Chrome, Safari or Firefox and pair again.

why.changed: The file just changed — refreshed, please check again
why.no_key: This phone has no approval key — pair again and retry
why.stale: Your phone's clock is too far off from your computer's
why.not_found: That item is no longer in the trash
why.exists: A different file with that name already exists — not overwritten
why.symlink: It's a symbolic link — skipped for safety
why.invalid: The task file has problems and can't be turned on
why.io: Couldn't read or write the file

mem.title: What it remembers
mem.intro: Your Agent reads these notes every time it starts work. They live on your computer. Delete any item: it goes to the trash on your computer first, and you can undo for 7 days.
mem.sources: Where {agent} keeps its memory (only these places):
mem.delText: It goes to the trash on your computer first. You can undo for 7 days.

act.title: Activity and approvals
act.intro: This record lives on your computer and is kept for 30 days.
act.off: Activity recording is off on your computer. Run agentj config activity on there to turn it on.

result.serve_stop: The program on your computer stopped — denied
result.policy: Outside the Agent's own safety settings — denied

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.intro: These are things your Agent can do on a schedule. You decide which ones run; after a task changes, turn it on again.
tasks.paused: ⛔ Everything is stopped: all scheduled tasks are paused. After you resume, each goes back to its own setting.
tasks.normal: Can draft · asks you whenever it needs your OK
tasks.textOn: "{title}" will run by itself {when} ({tz}){ro}. Whenever it needs your OK during a run, it still asks you first. If the task changes, you'll need to turn it on again.
tasks.textOff: "{title}" will no longer run by itself.

cron.monthly: on day {d} of every month at {hm}

revoked.title: This phone was removed by your computer
revoked.lead: Your computer no longer trusts this phone. To keep using it, run `agentj pair` on your computer and pair again.
revoked.draft: Your unsent draft, your input history and the key that encrypted them were deleted from this phone.

error.title: Disconnected
error.pairBad: The pairing data didn't check out, so we disconnected. Run agentj pair on your computer again.
error.dataBad: Received data that couldn't be verified, so we disconnected to protect your conversation.
error.noCrypto: This browser doesn't support the encryption we need. Try the latest Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
error.missing: This browser is missing features we need. Try the latest Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
error.noStore: Couldn't save this phone's device key (private browsing?). Try a normal window.

a2hs.title: Add it to your Home Screen to use it like an app
a2hs.ios: In Safari, tap the Share button at the bottom, then Add to Home Screen. Then open it from the Home Screen and pair there — lock-screen alerts also only work from the Home Screen app.
a2hs.android: In Chrome, tap ⋮ at the top right, then Add to Home Screen or Install app.

orb.title: Tap to change the text size, hold to reset

r.stale: Last synced at {hm}; it refreshes when the connection is back.

pill.unsupported: The Agent on the computer cannot switch models from the phone yet
pill.noEffort: This model has no effort levels to switch
pill.queued: The Agent is busy; it switches after this turn

why.unknown_model: the computer does not know this model

r.local: This has to be handled on the computer

err.novoice: This phone has no on-device voice (only the phone's own voices are used, so the text is never sent anywhere)
err.empty: Nothing to read in this one

share.copied: This device cannot share directly; copied — paste it where you want

quote.head: Reply · {who}
quote.gone: That one is no longer in the history

pend.question: A question is waiting
pend.permission: An action is waiting for you

appr.batchHold: Hold: approve, and auto-approve the same low-risk kind for the rest of this turn

appr.elsewhereLive: Or on the computer · the first answer counts

q.elsewhereLive: Or answer on the computer · the first answer counts
q.net: Not connected, nothing was sent; try again or answer on the computer

st.sent: Sent; waiting for it to apply
st.cancel_sent: Cancel sent; waiting for it to apply
st.cancelled: Question cancelled; type your answer instead
st.detached: The phone was disconnected; answer on the computer

mic.aria: Hold to talk, let go to turn it into text, slide up to cancel; double-tap to lock, tap again to finish
mic.title: Hold to talk · let go for text · slide up to cancel · double-tap to lock, tap again to finish

ptt.hint: Let go to turn it into text · slide up to cancel
ptt.longHint: Let go to attach it as audio · slide up to cancel
ptt.anyKeyEsc: Any key ends it · Esc cancels
ptt.tapEndSlide: Tap again to finish · slide up to cancel
ptt.tapEndEsc: Tap again to finish · Esc cancels
ptt.capped: The locked take reached {m} minutes and ended
ptt.ready: The microphone is ready; hold to talk
ptt.short: Hold to talk · double-tap to lock

asr.noSpeech: Didn't catch that; say it again
asr.not_installed: Voice transcription is not installed on the computer: run `agentj asr install` there (about 180 MB). Until then, use your keyboard's dictation.

asr.timeout: Transcription timed out; say it again
asr.bad_audio: This recording could not be read; say it again
asr.net: Transcription failed: not connected to the computer
asr.too_long: Too long; keep it shorter, or double-tap to lock for a long take (sent as an attachment)

voice.asAttNoAsr: A long take: attached as audio (no transcription on the computer; the Agent gets the audio file)

draft.restored: Restored the draft you had not sent

up.asr_off: Voice transcription is off on the computer
up.notReady: This file is not ready yet; wait a few seconds and pick it again

take.tooMany: At most {max} attachments: {have} already, {verb} {n}; none were added

clip.denied: Could not read the clipboard (tap “Paste” or allow clipboard access)

cam.noApi: This browser cannot use the camera directly

say.waitUploads: Waiting for the attachments to upload…

say.cancelNet: Not cancelled: not connected to the computer
say.withdrawn: Withdrawn: it was not given to the Agent; the text is back in the field

err.reply_unknown: The message you reply to is gone; cancel the reply and send again

run.model: See which models you can switch to

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.i: Enter / leave the field (with a suggestion list open, Esc closes it first)
keys.uk: Delete to the start / end of the line
keys.w: Delete the previous word (works in the installed web app window; in a normal Chrome tab on Windows / Linux it may close the tab)
keys.y: Paste back what was just deleted
keys.hist: With an empty field: earlier messages you sent
keys.scroll: Scroll up / down inside the reply
keys.f: Full-screen reader; inside, `+` `-` change the size, `Esc` / double-tap / `f` close it
keys.r: Reply to this one (the quote shows above the field, `Esc` cancels)
keys.q: Show this list (or the bulb at the top right)
keys.m: Hold to talk, let go for text
keys.mm: Lock the recording, it keeps going; any key ends it, Esc cancels
keys.mic: Lock the recording, it keeps going; tap again to finish, Esc cancels
keys.eei: Already empty (≥ 1 s): interrupt the current task
